component.name: ProtonHub
component.summary: Manage Proton, Wine, DXVK and VKD3D across game launchers

description.p: ProtonHub installs and removes compatibility tools such as GE-Proton, Proton-CachyOS, Wine-GE, DXVK and vkd3d-proton for Steam, Heroic, Lutris, Bottles and WineZGUI, and verifies every download against its published checksum.

ul.li: Set the tool each Steam and Heroic game runs with, one by one or in bulk
See which games use which tool, and delete the tools nothing uses
Keep tools at their latest release, daily, and move games onto it
See ProtonDB ratings and anti-cheat status for your games
Every failure is shown with its reason, ready to copy into a bug report
